nodes.label: Weekly Link Check Workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs on a Monday 06:00 UTC cron so external docs/download links in the tool catalog are verified weekly without manual effort.

nodes.label: RN Dev Setup Launcher
nodes.rationale: Single-page, click-driven launcher that takes a fresh Mac/Windows/Linux machine to a full React Native stack; no backend, all state in localStorage.

nodes.label: Data-Driven Tool Catalog
nodes.rationale: Everything is data-driven so adding or editing a tool requires no UI code changes — contributors only edit src/lib/tools.ts.

nodes.label: Action Helpers (cmd/link/mac/win)
nodes.rationale: Helpers keep tool entries terse: cmd() for copy-command actions, link() for open/download actions with auto Download labels, mac()/win() spread one action across both architectures.

nodes.label: Platform IDs (mac-arm, mac-intel, win-x64, win-arm, linux)
nodes.rationale: A platform with no actions entry greys the card out with 'Not available on your OS'.
nodes.norm_label: platform ids (mac-arm, mac-intel, win-x64, win-arm, linux)

nodes.label: Latest-Version Resolution Strategy
nodes.rationale: Cards install the latest version resolved at run time — nothing is pinned into the site so it never goes stale; version managers (fnm for Node, Corepack for pnpm) let a cloned repo's .nvmrc/packageManager/lockfiles snap to project-specific versions.

nodes.label: JDK 17 Deliberate Pin
nodes.rationale: The one deliberate version pin — React Native requires JDK 17 specifically, so the latest-version strategy is intentionally broken for it.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages Deployment
nodes.rationale: Chosen because it is free with no custom domain needed; every push to main builds and publishes to <username>.github.io/<repo>/.

nodes.label: Relative Vite Base ('./')
nodes.rationale: Vite base is './' (relative) so the same dist build works on GitHub Pages subpaths and as-is on Netlify or Vercel without rebuilding.

nodes.label: localStorage State Persistence
nodes.rationale: No backend — install progress is saved in the browser via localStorage.

nodes.label: Pre-Paint Theme Script
nodes.rationale: Applies the saved theme from localStorage before first paint to avoid a flash of wrong theme; dark is the default and the 'light' class is only added when explicitly saved.
